import html # Predefined format template for a blog post. # The placeholders are named 'title' and 'body'. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a user‑submitted blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The heading/title of the blog post. description : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped and formatted HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user input to prevent XSS attacks (CWE‑79). safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Return the formatted blog post. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
